question: Which among the following books is written by Amitav Ghosh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jungle Nama**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Amitav Ghosh is an esteemed Indian author, well-known for his works in English fiction.**
 
• Jungle Nama is a book written by** Amitav Ghosh and is his first attempt at a narrative in verse.**
 
• The book is based on the legend of** Bon Bibi, a traditional tale prevalent in the Sundarbans region of Bengal.**
 
• **Jungle Nama illustrates the complex relationship between humans **and the natural environment, presenting it in the form of an allegory.
 
• **The book was published in 2021.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
